transcript.speaker: Town Crier
transcript.text: Oyez! By order of Captain Valerius, Haven is placed under dusk curfew following the murder of Merchant Lycus! Watch patrols are doubled!

transcript.speaker: Ancient Relic
transcript.text: The Sunstone warms in your grasp, casting golden ripples of solar light across the ancient stones. Its power restores your vitality (+10 Health).
